rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than 0.6% in August 2024, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: The market will expire at the sooner of the first 10:00 AM following the release of the data, or one week following the scheduled release of the data (scheduled for September 11, 2024).
